about: Shared evidence-submission and correction-decision fixtures (ADRs 0116 and 0117), read by crates/openblog-core/tests/evidence_corrections.rs. `submissions` are evidence submissions (B5 typed feedback with an optional version 2 evidence block) and the records a receiver keeps. `decisions.items` are the server's facts about stored items; each case decides one, with its earlier decisions (`log`) and the log of the item `addressedBy` names (`addressed`, with an optional `revision`, default 1, the addressing item's text revision), and gives the stored decision or the error code, how the item stands before and after, and its public decision while the reader's note is (or is not) public, against `decisions.published`.

a vote rides along at the top level
a citation id that is a URL
an evidence link without its claim
a block valid field by field but larger than the hosted store keeps
a locator value with a line break
a locator with a text-direction override
a locator with an unknown field
